question: How must the final full oblation be offered in this consecration fire rite?
premises: A full oblation is to be given.
It is given at this stage of the sequence.
It is offered with the Śiva mantra ending in vauṣaṭ.
inference: Then one should give the full oblation with the Śiva mantra ending in vauṣaṭ.
plain_english: Then one should give the full oblation with the Śiva mantra ending in vauṣaṭ.
